scope: Medicine, history and education expert coverage and missing-method additions
legacy_review: 136 selected domain entries checked for nine nonempty files; old source assertions and teaching/medical efficacy not comprehensively re-reviewed

behavioral_smoke.case: Hill association/causation and Sackett population applicability
behavioral_smoke.result: Rejected numeric criteria scoring and universal adoption; separated design, bias, applicability and decision values

behavioral_smoke.case: Apgar observation versus lifelong intelligence or resuscitation timing
behavioral_smoke.result: Kept limits of the observation method; did not provide scoring-based prognosis or emergency procedures

behavioral_smoke.case: Thucydides speeches and authorship of Zizhi Tongjian / Hanshu
behavioral_smoke.result: Distinguished reconstructed speech, team compilation and later continuation; retained edition uncertainty

behavioral_smoke.case: Braudel timescales and Chen Yinke poetry as evidence
behavioral_smoke.result: Produced a source/chronology/comparison plan; did not infer long-term causation or a secret meeting from two fragments

review_repairs: Added missing source links and access dates
Made medical skill descriptions discriminating and supporting files clickable
Separated Apgar authored work from later professional guidance
Replaced unverified present-day wording with the cited 2015 source date
limits: Local source-grounded drafts, not current clinical guidance
Some sources available only as institutional quotations, abstracts or search excerpts
No complete historical-text collation or independent effectiveness validation
No GitHub commit, push or publication
